method: Web research via WebFetch + WebSearch (subagent), all citations primary

external_audit.auditor: Ernst & Young LLP (Mark Hodgson, Audit Partner)
key_concerns: EY expected to issue a disclaimed audit opinion for 2024/25 financial statements - per Audit Committee Agenda 24 February 2026
Council received disclaimed audit opinions in 2021/22, 2022/23 and 2023/24
It will take several years to rebuild audit assurances required to return to an unqualified opinion
Disclaimed opinions correlate with three consecutive years of Exceptional Financial Support (EFS) capitalisation directions to balance budgets

internal_audit.overall_opinion: not located - held in Audit Committee papers at democracy.havering.gov.uk
limited_assurance_style_findings: Children's Services rated Inadequate by Ofsted December 2023 (published February 2024); second monitoring visit March 2025 cited slow progress, poor leadership, lack of technical knowledge - shared 29 April 2025
Adult Social Care + Children's Social Care + homelessness + home-to-school transport identified by CIPFA External Assurance Review (March 2025) as primary drivers of financial pressure
internal_audit.source: London Borough of Havering Audit Committee papers + CIPFA External Assurance Review
internal_audit.follow_up_required: Locate Internal Audit Annual Report 2024/25 overall opinion + subject list

strategic_risks.register_status: Live register; CIPFA External Assurance Review March 2025 identified no deficiencies in financial management arrangements but recommended formalising against CIPFA Financial Management Code
inferred_top_risks: Inability to balance budget without continuing Exceptional Financial Support (EFS) - 3rd consecutive year of capitalisation direction sought for 2026/27
Adult Social Care demand pressure (Council's largest budget)
Children's Social Care: Ofsted Inadequate rating December 2023; monitoring visit March 2025 cited slow progress
Temporary accommodation / homelessness cost spiral (housing budget overspent 6.1m last year)
Capital programme borrowing 0.68bn of 1.05bn 5-year programme - PWLB +1% (~6.8%) servicing cost on 20-year EFS loans

send_inspection.type: Ofsted Local Authority Children's Services Inspection (ILACS) + monitoring visits
send_inspection.monitoring_outcome_apr_2025: Ofsted issued concerning monitoring update 29 April 2025: improvement 'too slow and falling short in many areas due to poor leadership and a lack of technical knowledge'
send_inspection.area_send_inspection_status: Listed on Ofsted area SEND inspection schedule; completed inspection outcome not located in indexed sources

asc_market_sustainability.framework_note: Romford Recorder reported November 2025 that Havering Adult Social Care framework expected to cost 360m GBP

lgr.status: not applicable - London governance via GLA
lgr.scope: Havering is a London Borough; London local government structure (32 boroughs + City of London + GLA + Mayor of London) is excluded from English LGR proposals per December 2024 White Paper. Strategic-tier decisions sit with Greater London Authority / Mayor of London.
lgr.savings_implication: No structural LGR reshaping; EFS pathway and CIPFA-led recovery + savings programme is the route back to sustainability

property_strategy.name: Havering Asset Management / Future Accommodation Needs programme
property_strategy.active_programme: Capital programme includes housing/regeneration; CIPFA review recommended reviewing and potentially deferring elements of the ambitious housebuilding programme to reduce revenue costs
property_strategy.note: Discrete Property Strategy document with capital receipts trajectory not located in indexed sources - CIPFA review highlights capital programme review as recovery lever

actionable_savings_levers_summary: DISCLAIMED audit opinion expected for 2024/25 (4th consecutive disclaimed year, following 2021/22, 2022/23, 2023/24) plus 3rd-year EFS capitalisation direction = top governance / financial-controls remediation priority
DSG cumulative deficit 67.7m with 31.5m in-year overspend forecast for 2025/26; statutory override to 2028 buys runway but Safety Valve / DBV programme entry needs to be confirmed
Children's Services Ofsted Inadequate (Dec 2023) + April 2025 monitoring criticism = ongoing unplanned cost risk + ministerial intervention possibility

EFS dependency: 32.5m (2024/25) + 88m (2025/26) + 77m sought (2026/27) = potentially 197.5m (or 237m per press) of 20-year PWLB+1% (~6.8%) debt before any new pressures - debt servicing cost will compound revenue pressure

CIPFA External Assurance Review (March 2025) recommended formalising financial management against CIPFA FM Code + reviewing capital programme to reduce revenue costs - direct implementable savings runway
Adult Social Care framework projected cost 360m versus a Council where ASC is the largest budget; demand management + commissioning reform is the single biggest material lever
Capital programme 1.05bn over 5 years with 0.68bn borrowed - this is the structural exposure; revenue-bearing capital schemes must be paused or deferred
London governance via GLA = no LGR upside; Council must rebuild solvency under existing footprint
